name: Freightliner Custom Chassis Manufacturing Plant - Gaffney SC

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (ROOFTOP, moved 2489m) landed near the FCCC plant. Confirmed via FCCC contact page and SC Commerce / SC Governor releases - 552 Hyatt Street, Gaffney SC, ~289,000 sq ft, three production lines, building RV/motorhome and walk-in-van custom chassis. Working center set on the main plant building.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Campus is fenced (chain-link along the road frontage and around the east storage yard). A small white ~1-vehicle-footprint structure sits at a gated internal road junction between the main plant and the east chassis-storage building, controlling truck movement - treated as a controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: The small white structure at the gated internal junction has the footprint and position of a guard/check booth; called guardShack true at medium confidence (could be an equipment shed) - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed at dock doors on the N face of the main plant building; estimate 10-25 doors, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large finished-chassis storage yard to the east plus extensive chassis/trailer staging around the main plant - clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated standalone chassis/trailer storage lot east of the main plant, full of completed chassis.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: High capacity because the east lot and surrounding aprons hold hundreds of completed chassis/RVs; ~250 estimate.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail line runs along the SW edge with spurs toward the plant.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Main plant building plus a separate east chassis-storage building, connected by an internal road = multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound parts docks on the N face are separate from the east finished-chassis storage / outbound flow.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The internal approach from the gated junction to the dock/yard areas is long, holding 3+ vehicles.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Gaffney is a small South Carolina town; the plant sits in an edge-of-town industrial area among woods and scattered residential - Rural.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Lane count at the internal gate not clearly resolvable - flagged uncertain.
